Proposition
[Eigenvalues of $S^n$ (Proposition K.20)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0369 ↗ prop:chow-iv-k19-harmonic-polynomial-decomposition 1. appk:K.20\group Sphere Spectrum

The eigenvalues of the Laplacian on functions on the unit sphere are \[ \lambda _k=k(k+n-1),\qquad k\in \mathbb N\cup \{ 0\} , \] with eigenspace the restrictions of $\mathcal H_k$.
